text: Vantora Sentry detects and responds to threats across endpoints, servers and cloud workloads using behavioural models, and groups related alerts so an analyst can triage them in one view.
Sentry detection models are updated monthly, and analyst feedback on each alert is used to reduce false alarms over time.
Every automated alert or block in Sentry comes with a plain-language explanation and the evidence behind it, which an analyst can review and overrule.
All data and all AI processing can stay inside the customer's country, either in the customer's own data centre or in an in-country cloud region.
Conductor creates and updates tickets in ServiceNow and Jira Service Management through supported connectors.
Other service desk and collaboration tools can be connected through an open interface.
note: This needs integration work during the project; it is not a ready-made connector.

text: Both products support single sign-on and role-based access control.
Sentry includes compliance report templates for common security standards.
note: Templates specific to healthcare regulation are on the roadmap and are not available today.

text: Conductor automates patching and remediation, and keeps a human approval step for any change marked high-risk.
Both products, including their AI models, can run entirely in the customer's own data centre, with no connection to an outside service.
Vantora Assure provides support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, with a 30 minute response target for critical incidents.
Vantora Launch is a fixed-scope implementation service that reaches full operation in 12 weeks, in three stages.
Vantora Academy trains administrators and analysts, with hands-on labs and a certification, included in the subscription.
A mobile app for approvals is planned.
note: Today, on-call staff use the web console on a phone browser. There is no mobile app.

text: Sentry does not discover or monitor medical devices itself.
note: It can take in a feed from a specialist medical device tool chosen by the customer.

text: Pricing is a subscription per device, with no charges based on data volume.
Vantora can provide customer references in finance, government and education.
note: Only one healthcare reference is available today.

text: Vantora does not provide backup and recovery.
note: Sentry and Conductor work alongside the customer's backup tool and can trigger its recovery steps.

text: Sentry and Conductor share one console and one software agent, so security and management run from a single place.
Per-device pricing bands are agreed up front, so new sites can be added at a known price.
